items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Well he was about the most sensational drummer we had.

ctx.x: Which one? I know three of them. I knew three. You understand which one? Red Happy and Black Happy. Red Happy and Tom. Red Happy.

Well he was about the most sensational drummer we had. Because he could, I suppose that guy, if you had a hundred little things there, you could hit him at the same time. He was just that fast. He was the whirlwind. Oh my. I'm telling you.

Black Happy had a stroke, but he still, he can walk around some day, he gets out some, you know? Oh yeah, we have. You remember Black Happy, huh? He was another drummer too. Probably so. You'd know him if you saw him, Goldson. And then all the Matthews brothers, there was a happy among all the Matthews, you know Bill? Oh Bill I hope. Yeah. Well he had another brother, Bebe, and another one happy.
